text:
samir: heads-up — found a small repro where the request-id gets re-inserted into logs after we thought redaction scrubbed it. Node SDK + OTEL shim + auth retry involved. steps below.

samir: repro steps (super small):
```
git clone https://example.com/redwood/sample-telemetry-repro.git
cd sample-telemetry-repro
# start server with debug logs
NODE_ENV=dev DEBUG=redwood:* node server.js
# trigger a failing auth then retry:
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer bad-token' http://localhost:3000/api/echo
```

emily: oh no :facepalm: can you paste the minimal log snippet where the id comes back?

samir: sure — here's the sequence (sanitized):
```
2026-03-22T15:02:01.123Z info inbound-headers scrubbed X-Request-ID: <redacted>
2026-03-22T15:02:01.456Z warn auth: token invalid -> retrying
2026-03-22T15:02:01.457Z debug retry-middleware re-emitting headers X-Request-ID: 8f3a1b2c
2026-03-22T15:02:01.458Z info http-request logged X-Request-ID: 8f3a1b2c
```

jia: I think I've seen something similar in the electron sample on mac — the otel hook that scrubs headers runs earlier than the retry middleware so when retry replays the request it reattaches the original header.

mike: which Node SDK / otel shim versions? could be the hook ordering change we shipped last week.

samir: node-sdk@1.7.3 + otel-shim@0.4.1. I instrumented middleware order: inbound otel-hook -> redaction -> auth-check -> retry-wrapper. but retry-wrapper clones the original req.headers snapshot (pre-scrub) if the auth token cache exists.

telemetry-bot: automated-alert: potential PII leak detected in logs for trace 0x7f3b (severity: notice). See https://console.internal/alerts/789 (auto-created).

emily: any short-term mitigations?

samir: quick mitigations: 1) move redaction into the outbound hook that runs just before send-back, or 2) ensure retry copies headers from the active request object rather than a saved pre-scrub snapshot. I tested (2) locally and it stops the ID reappearing.

jia: can you add a tiny integration test in the sample app that fails before the fix? makes it easier for platform to guard regressions.

samir: yep — filing a tiny PR with test + suggested fix. pinging @emily and @mike for review when ready.
emily: thanks — please @mention the eng-infra oncall if the alert triggers again so we can mute noise.

samir: will do. thanks everyone.
